summary: Harden the optional, unwired Rust sidebar v2 allocator, membership page conversion, edit lifecycle and durable journal directory without activating any client.

replay.detail: No replay or persisted-state migration. Previously staged action IDs and idempotency keys remain reserved across retries and recovery.

schema.detail: No wire or journal format change. Membership pages now enforce the generated API version, page kind and schema limit of 1 through 200. The existing live-count cap remains post-decode; moving it before allocation requires a decoder change.

rules.detail: No projection or retention changes. The unwired key allocator refuses more than 4096 keys. An edit retains at most 256 newly staged identities before refusing another attempt as InvalidPlan; existing journals retain their full identity history.

compatibility.detail: No activated client behavior changes. Rust Edits status is read-only through status(); inconsistent Fresh events refuse instead of panicking. Journal persistence tightens existing owned directories to 0700 and refuses foreign-owned or symlink directories.

recovery.detail: Revert the change. Journal bytes and reserved identity history remain readable by the previous implementation.
